## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 1 passages

- **ep**: Farmer filed the first formal criminal complaint, to the NYPD on August 29, 1996 and the FBI days later. She then spent twenty-nine years being treated as unreliable, because the document proving she had reported was in the government's files and not public. When the Justice Department released it in December 2025 she identified herself and said she had waited thirty years and they could not call her a liar any more. She sued the Department in July 2025 over the FBI's inaction. Her sister Annie Farmer testified at Maxwell's trial. The pair bracket the record: the first report in 1996 and one of the four trial witnesses in 2021.
